definitions.explanation: The nature and composition of the ground or earth in a particular area, including rock types, soil, and underground structures.
The scientific study of the earth's physical structure and substance.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}の{地質|ちしつ}は{不安定|ふあんてい}だ。
examples.english: The geology of this area is unstable.

examples.japanese: {地質|ちしつ}{調査|ちょうさ}の{結果|けっか}、{断層|だんそう}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: A geological survey found a fault line.

examples.japanese: {建設|けんせつ}{前|まえ}に{地質|ちしつ}{調査|ちょうさ}を{行|おこな}う{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: It is necessary to conduct a geological survey before construction.

examples.japanese: {地質|ちしつ}{学|がく}を{専攻|せんこう}している。
{地質|ちしつ}{学者|がくしゃ}が{火山|かざん}{地帯|ちたい}の{岩石|がんせき}を{分析|ぶんせき}している。
examples.english: Geologists are analyzing rocks from the volcanic zone.

examples.japanese: {地質|ちしつ}{学|がく}は{地球|ちきゅう}の{歴史|れきし}を{岩石|がんせき}や{地層|ちそう}から{読|よ}み{解|と}く{学問|がくもん}だ。
examples.english: Geology is a discipline that reads the history of the Earth from rocks and strata.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {地質|ちしつ}{調査|ちょうさ} (geological survey)
- {地質|ちしつ}{学|がく} (geology - the science)
- {地質|ちしつ}{学者|がくしゃ} (geologist)
- {地質|ちしつ}{図|ず} (geological map)
- {地質|ちしつ}{時代|じだい} (geological era)

RELATED TO CONSTRUCTION:
Before building, {地質|ちしつ}{調査|ちょうさ} is conducted to assess:
- Ground stability
- Soil composition
- Earthquake resistance
- Underground water

This is especially important in earthquake-prone Japan.
